# apipbx_call_limit (Resource)

A tenant's limit on calls in progress at once. Import with the tenant id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `max_calls` (Number) The most calls the tenant may have in progress at once (1-100000); one over it gets a busy signal.
- `tenant_id` (String) One lot per tenant.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
